title: 第7章 收集灵稻第8章 批量种植
content_zh:
;;
陈平起身，站在那株金黄的灵谷前，伸出手。
指尖微颤，碰触了一下最下面的谷子。
坚硬、饱满。
是真的粮食。能填饱肚子的粮食。属于他自己的粮食。
喜悦冲击着他，让他一时无措。
他绕着灵谷转了几圈，咧着嘴，喉咙里发出声音。
过了一会儿，他才压下情绪，想起更重要的事：收获。
他从腰间取下那根硬木棍。
用棍子尖端，小心地去撬稻穗与茎秆的连接处。
枝梗很韧，但成熟后也变脆了。
他不敢太用力，怕碰掉谷粒。
一点一点地撬动，终于，“咔”一声轻响，稻穗脱离茎秆，落进他手里。
分量很足。
他捧着这第一穗灵谷。
接着，他动作快起来。
用硬木棍当工具，或撬或割，小心地将剩下的稻穗一一取下。
成熟后的枝梗容易处理。
很快，那株灵谷只剩下光秃的茎秆立在黑土地上。
陈平身前，堆放着三十个沉甸甸的稻穗。

每一个都很饱满。
他坐下，开始处理这些稻穗。
用手掌搓，用指甲剥，将一粒粒灵谷从穗轴上分离。
这个过程需要耐心。
他全神贯注，一粒一粒地剥离。
谷粒掉在黑土地上，发出沙沙声。
时间过去。
陈平忘记了疲惫，忘记了外界。
终于，最后一粒谷子从穗轴上脱落。
陈平看着眼前堆起的一小堆灵谷，长吁了一口气。
他开始计数。
他用手捧，一捧一捧地数。
每一捧大约能抓一两百粒。
他数得很仔细。
一捧，两捧……十捧……二十捧……
最终，他得到了一个数字：六千粒。
content_en:
;;
Chen Ping stood up, stood in front of the golden spiritual valley, and stretched out his hand.
The fingertips trembled slightly and touched the bottom grain.
Firm and full.
It's real food. Food that can fill your stomach. His own food.
Joy hit him, leaving him at a loss.
He circled the spiritual valley several times, grinning and making sounds in his throat.
After a while, he suppressed his emotions and remembered something more important: harvest.
He took the hard wooden stick from his waist.
Use the tip of a stick to carefully pry the connection between the rice ear and the stem.
The branches and stems are tough but become brittle as they mature.
He didn't dare to use too much force for fear of knocking off the grains.
He pried it bit by bit, and finally, with a soft "click" sound, the rice ear broke away from the stalk and fell into his hand.
Portions are generous.
He was holding the first Suiling Valley.
Then, he moved quickly.
Use a hardwood stick as a tool, pry or cut, and carefully remove the remaining rice ears one by one.
Mature branches and stems are easy to handle.
Soon, only the bare stems of the spiritual valley tree were left standing on the black soil.
In front of Chen Ping, thirty heavy ears of rice were piled up.
Each one is filling.
He sat down and began to work on the ears of rice.
Rub it with your palms and peel it with your nails to separate the grains of spiritual grain from the cob.
This process requires patience.
He concentrated on peeling off the pieces one by one.
The grains fell on the black earth and made a rustling sound.
Time passes.
Chen Ping forgot about fatigue and the outside world.
Finally, the last grain of millet fell off the cob.
Chen Ping looked at the small pile of spiritual grains piled up in front of him and let out a long breath.
He started counting.
He held them in his hands and counted them one by one.
Each handful can hold about one to two hundred pills.
He counted carefully.
One handful, two handfuls... ten handfuls... twenty handfuls...
Finally, he got a number: six thousand grains.
